scripts.deploy:mirror: zsh -c 'source ~/.zshrc >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist' && node qa/mirror-check.mjs || { echo ""; echo "!!! MIRROR STEP FAILED !!!"; echo "!!! Production IS deployed and gated — it is the MIRROR that is stale. !!!"; echo "!!! Re-run: npm run deploy:mirror   (does not touch production) !!!"; exit 1; }
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=englishgate-site --branch=main && npm run gate:deploy && npm run deploy:mirror
scripts.gate:deploy: node qa/post-deploy-gate.mjs --expect dist/index.html || { echo ""; echo "!!! POST-DEPLOY GATE FAILED — THE DEPLOY IS NOT DONE !!!"; echo "!!! Fix production or roll back. Do NOT edit the gate. !!!"; exit 1; }
